title: Prohibition of Administrative Overhead & Waste Surcharges
gazette_citation: State Healthcare Establishment Guidelines on Overhead Billing Transparency & CEA Directives
description: Prohibits hospital establishments from unbundling administrative file opening charges, bio-medical waste disposal, and general disinfection surcharges as separate line items to patients.

title: NPPA Statutory Ceiling on Medical Protective Consumables
gazette_citation: The Gazette of India: Extraordinary, Part II—Sec. 3(ii), Order S.O. 1492(E)
description: National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority notification regulating permissible retail prices and trade margins on PPE kits and related epidemic/inpatient supplies.

title: Sterile Examination & Surgical Gloves Margin Cap
gazette_citation: DPCO Order on Monitored Disposables and Drug Delivery Systems
description: Restricts unreasonable markups on basic single-use surgical and examination gloves.
